text.tspan: MANDATORY CORRESPONDENCE / exact selected closure + complete event inventory
Scheme owns source/lifecycle semantics. Go reports cloud state. Rust enforces the reference ledger/broker boundaries.
Lost replies do not undo authoritative state. A claim does not prove submission, and a result does not close an old emitter.
Each physical event must preserve the operation binding, state transition and safety invariant.
Reply may be lost / knowledge unknown
Separate from consume and its reply
Old worker may resume after check
One claim / one local send handle
Gate proof is not a physical stop
